# betterado_user_entitlement (Resource)

Manages a user entitlement within Azure DevOps.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "betterado_user_entitlement" "example" {
  principal_name       = "user@example.com"
  account_license_type = "express"
  licensing_source     = "account"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `account_license_type` (String) The account license type of the user. Defaults to 'express'.
- `licensing_source` (String) The licensing source of the user. Defaults to 'account'.
- `origin` (String) The origin of the user, e.g. 'aad' or 'ghb'.
- `origin_id` (String) The origin ID of the user. Used when origin is set.
- `principal_name` (String) The principal name, i.e. the e-mail address, of the user.

### Read-Only

- `descriptor` (String) The descriptor of the user.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
